description: This file defines a React component for managing Single Sign-On (SSO) configurations via modals, including loading existing settings, editing, saving, and clearing them. It also provides UI for setup instructions.

classes.name: SSOModalsProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining props accepted by the SSOModals React component.

classes.name: SSOProviderConfig
classes.description: TypeScript interface representing configuration details for each SSO provider.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: React hook that loads existing SSO settings when the modal becomes visible and updates form fields accordingly.

methods.name: loadSSOSettings
methods.description: Async function invoked within useEffect to fetch current SSO settings and populate the form.

methods.name: handleFormSubmit
methods.description: Asynchronous function that handles form submission, saving settings via API and proceeding to show setup instructions.

methods.name: handleClearSSO
methods.description: Async function to clear all SSO settings by resetting backend data and updating the form.

methods.name: renderProviderFields
methods.description: Helper to render dynamic form fields based on selected SSO provider configuration.
